messages.subject_clean: Calibration using RSWAT for SWAT+ without using graphical user interface
messages.body_plain:
There are several issues with your setup that RSWAT cannot run
1. extraction from the "hru_wb_day" file does not support by RSWAT (you need to define your own extraction function
2. if you have only one observed data file, the name must be "obs_var_1.txt", but you used "obs_var_2.txt"
Hope this helps

messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,

I’m encountering an issue with the calibration of my SWAT model. Despite making changes to the model parameters (such as awc.sol, cn2.hru, esco.hru,..), the simulation results remain unchanged. I have ensured that the configuration files are correctly modified and that the simulations are recalculated after each change, but nothing seems to impact the results.

I’ve also tried expanding the range of parameter values and deleting the old output files before rerunning the simulations, but the problem persists. I’m starting to suspect that there might be a general configuration issue with the model, preventing the parameter changes from being properly implemented.

Do you have any suggestions for diagnosing this issue? Are there specific steps I should check to ensure that the changes are being correctly applied in the model?
Thank you in advance for your help,

Oumaima,

messages.subject: "multibyte string character" error closes the R-SWAT GUI
messages.subject_clean: "multibyte string character" error closes the R-SWAT GUI
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I had a problem when  pasting the TxtInOut folder path in R-SWAT. It  suddenly closes and then it brought me back to RStudio showing the message:
Warning: Error in nchar: invalid multibyte string, element 1  48: getInfoHruHeader 47: getHruInfo 46: observe [C:\Users\acer\AppData\Local\R\win-library\4.3\RSWAT\R-SWAT/server.R#618] 45: <observer> 2: shiny::runApp 1: showRSWAT
I asked Tam V. Nguyen about it and the problem was all my .hru files had an unusual space character in the first line between "a. m"
SOLUTION:  use this command in RStudio:

Sys.setlocale( 'LC_ALL','C' )

showRSWAT()
Once I did that, the problem was solved.
Hope it helps!

Best to all,

Rayén Rivera Vidal
Geóloga UdeC

Doctora(c) en Ciencias Ambientales con mención en Sistemas Acuáticos Continentales

Facultad de Ciencias Ambientales – Centro EULA

Universidad de Concepción - Chile
